name: n4_list_px_views
description: List the Px views (baja:PxView) below root with one BQL query: display_name, px_file (the file:^ ORD to pass to n4_read_file / n4_px_summary) and media. A PxView is a property value, not a component, so the station usually answers its slot path as NULL: slot_path and owner_path are null then (see owner_note).
